Haa-Meem .
yeh kitab Allah ki taraf say utaari jarahi hai jo bara sahab-e-iqtidar , bara sahab-e-hikmat hai .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay aasmano aur zameen mein manney walon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain .
aur khud tumhari pedaeesh mein , aur unn janweron mein jo uss ney ( zameen mein ) phela rakhay hain , unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo yaqeen keren .

neez raat aur din kay aaney janey mein , aur Allah ney aasman say rizq ka jo zariya utaara , phir uss say zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad naee zindagi di , uss mein aur hawaon ki gardish mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo aqal say kaam len .
yeh Allah ki aayaten hain jo hum tumhen theek theek parh ker suna rahey hain . abb Allah aur uss ki aayaton kay baad kon si baat hai jiss per yeh log emaan layen gay-?
bura ho har uss jhootay gunehgaar ka

jo Allah ki aayaten sunta hai jabkay woh ussay parh ker sunai jarahi hoti hain , phir bhi woh takabbur kay aalam mein iss tarah ( kufr per ) arra rehta hai jaisay uss ney woh aayaten suni hi nahi . lehaza aesay shaks ko dardnak azab ki  khushkhabri  suna do .
aur jab humari aayaton mein say koi aayat aesay shaks kay ilm mein aati hai to woh uss ka mazaq banata hai . aesay logon  ko woh azab hoga jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .

unn kay aagay jahannum hai , aur jo kuch unhon ney kamaya hai , naa woh unn kay kuch kaam aaye ga , aur naa woh kaam ayen gay jinn ko unhon ney Allah kay bajaye apna rakhwala bana rakha hai . aur unn kay hissay mein aik zabardast azab aaye ga .
yeh ( Quran ) sarapa hidayat hai , aur jinn logon  ney apney perwerdigar ki aayaton ka inkar kiya hai , unn kay liye bala ka dardnak azab hai .
Allah woh hai jiss ney samandar ko tumharay kaam mein laga diya hai , takay uss kay hukum say uss mein kashtiyan chalen , aur takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero ,   aur takay tum shukar ada kero .

aur aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai , uss sabb ko uss ney apni taraf say tumharay kaam mein laga rakha hai . yaqeenan iss mein unn logon  kay liye bari nishaniyan hain jo ghor-o-fiker say kaam len .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log emaan ley aaye hain , unn say kaho kay jo log Allah kay dino ka andesha nahi rakhtay   unn say darguzar keren ,   takay Allah logon  ko unn kamon ka badla dey jo woh kiya kertay thay .

jo shaks bhi naik kaam kerta hai , woh apney hi faeeday kay liye kerta hai , aur jo bura kaam kerta hai , woh apna hi nuqsan kerta hai , phir tum sabb ko apney perwerdigar hi kay paas wapis laya jaye ga .
aur hum ney bano Israel ko kitab , aur hukoomat aur nabwooat ata ki thi , aur unhen pakeezah cheezon ka rizq diya tha , aur unhen duniya jahan kay logon  per foqiyat bakhshi thi ,

aur unhen khulay khulay ehkaam diye thay . iss kay baad unn mein jo ikhtilaf peda huwa , woh unn kay paas ilm aajaney kay baad hi huwa , sirf iss liye kay unn ko aik doosray say zidd hogaee thi .   yaqeenan tumhara perwerdigar unn kay darmiyan qayamat kay din unn baaton ka faisla kerday ga jinn mein woh ikhtilaf kiya kertay thay .

phir ( aey payghumber ! ) hum ney tumhen deen ki aik khaas shariyat per rakha hai , lehaza tum ussi ki perwi kero , aur unn logon  ki khuwaishaat kay peechay naa chalna jo haqeeqat ka ilm nahi rakhtay .
woh Allah kay muqablay mein tumharay zara bhi kaam nahi aa-saktay . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay zalim log aik doosray kay dost hain , aur Allah muttaqi logon  ka dost hai .
yeh ( Quran ) tamam logon  kay liye baseeraton ka majmooa hai , aur jo log yaqeen keren , unn kay liye manzil tak phonchaney ka zariya aur sarapa rehmat hai .

jinn logon  ney buray buray kamon ka irtikab kiya hai , kiya woh yeh samjhay huye hain kay enhen/unhen hum inn/unn logon  kay barabar kerden gay jo emaan laye hain , aur jinhon ney naik amal kiye hain , jiss kay nateejay mein inn/unn ka jeena aur marna aik hi jaisa hojaye-?   kitni buri baat hai jo yeh tey kiye huye hain !

Allah ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko bar-haq maqsad kay liye peda kiya hai , aur iss liye kiya hai kay her shaks ko uss kay kiye huye kamon ka badla diya jaye , aur detay waqt unn per koi zulm naa kiya jaye .

phir kiya tum ney ussay bhi dekha jiss ney apna khuda apni nafsani khuwaish ko bana liya hai , aur ilm kay bawajood Allah ney ussay gumrahi mein daal diya , aur uss kay kaan aur dil per mohar laga di , aur uss ki aankh per perda daal diya ? abb Allah kay baad kon hai jo ussay raastay per laye-? kiya phir bhi tum log sabaq nahi letay-?

aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  jo kuch zindagi hai , bus yehi humari dunyawi zindagi hai , ( issi mein ) hum martay aur jeetay hain aur hamen koi aur nahi , zamana hi halak ker deta hai .  halankay iss baat ka unhen kuch bhi ilm nahi hai , bus wehmi andazay lagatay hain .

aur jab humari aayaten poori wazahat kay sath unn ko parh ker sunai jati hain to yeh kehney kay siwa unn ki koi daleel nahi hoti kay :  agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko ( zinda ker kay ) ley aao .

keh do kay Allah hi tumhen zindagi deta hai , phir woh tumhen moat dey ga , phir tum sabb ko qayamat kay din jama keray ga   jiss mein kissi qisam ka koi shak nahi hai , lekin aksar log samajhtay nahi hain .
aur aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat Allah hi ki hai , aur jiss din qayamat aa-khari hogi , uss din jo log batil per hain , woh sakht nuqsan uthayen gay .

aur tum her giroh ko dekho gay kay woh ghuttnon kay ball gira huwa hai .   her giroh ko uss kay aemal namay ki taraf bulaya jaye ga , ( aur kaha jaye ga kay : )  aaj tumhen unn aemal ka badla diya jaye ga jo tum kiya kertay thay .
yeh humara ( likhwaya huwa ) daftar hai jo tumharay baaray mein theek theek bol raha hai . tum jo kuch kertay thay , hum uss sabb ko likhwa liya kertay thay .
chunacheh jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko to unn ka perwerdigar apni rehmat mein dakhil keray ga yehi khuli hoi kamiyabi hai

rahey woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya tha , ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  bhala kiya tumharay samney meri aayaten nahi parhi jati then-? phir bhi tum ney takabbur say kaam liya , aur mujrim banay rahey ,

aur jab tum say kaha jata tha kay Allah ka wada sacha hai , aur qayamat woh haqeeqat hai jiss mein koi bhi shak nahi hai , to tum yeh kehtay thay kay :  hum nahi jantay kay qayamat kiya hoti hai ? uss kay baaray mein hum jo kuch khayal kertay hain , bus aik gumaan saa hota hai , aur hamen yaqeen bilkul nahi hai .
aur ( uss moaqa per ) unhon ney jo aemal kiye thay , unn ki buraiyan khul ker unn kay samney aajayen gi , aur jiss cheez ka woh mazaq uratay thay , wohi unn ko aa-gheray gi ,

aur unn say kaha jaye ga kay :  aaj hum tumhen ussi tarah bhula den gay jaisay tum ney yeh baat bhula daali thi kay tumhen apney iss din ka samna kerna hoga , aur tumhara thikana aag hai , aur tumhen kissi qisam kay madadgaar moyassar nahi ayen gay .

yeh sabb iss liye kay tum ney Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq banaya tha , aur dunyawi zindagi ney tumhen dhokay mein daal diya tha .  chunacheh aaj aesay logon  ko naa wahan say nikala jaye ga , aur naa unn say moaafi maangney ko kaha jaye ga .
gharz tareef tamam tarr Allah ki hai jo saray aasmano ka bhi malik hai , zameen ka bhi malik , aur tamam jahano ka bhi malik .
aur tamam tarr barai ussi ko hasil hai , aasmano mein bhi , aur zameen mein bhi , aur wohi hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .
